patthana12.3:3.1: Nahetuṃ nasāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nahetuṃ naanāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.3:7.1: Nahetuṃ naanāsavañceva nano ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.3:9.1: Nahetuṃ naāsavavippayuttañceva nano ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.3:10.1: Nahetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ nasāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nahetuṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ naanāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
